description.default: Auto-number figures, tables and equations and keep cross-references in sync. Right-click a paragraph to set a caption (figure below, table above) and clear it in one go; equations only have their number touched. Filter the picker by kind and section. Interface in 10 languages.
description.zh-CN: 自动为图、表、公式编号并同步交叉引用。右键段落设为题注（图题在下、表题在上），取消一次清净；公式只改编号不动正文。面板可按类型与章节筛选，界面支持 10 种语言。
